sources.title: Adilbai/ppo-SnowballTarget · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent trained to play the SnowballTarget environment from Unity ML-Agents. The agent, named Julien the Bear 🐻, learns to accurately throw snowballs at spawning targets to maximize rewards.

sources.snippet: ppo-SnowballTarget huggingface.co ppo-SnowballTarget huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides ppo-SnowballTarget's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this MRNH ppo-SnowballTarget model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the ppo-SnowballTarget model, and also provides paid use of the ppo-SnowballTarget.
